labels.text: section 63(c)(2)(C), as modified by section 63(c)(7) for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2017: the basic standard deduction 'in any other case' (single individuals and married individuals filing separately)

section 63(c)(2)(C): $3,000, unindexed statutory base; before inflation adjustment under section 63(c)(4) (base year 1987) — no Rev. Proc. published amount for any pre-2018 year is pinned here (SOURCE_GAP)

section 63(c)(7)(A)(ii): $12,000, unindexed statutory base for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2017 and before January 1, 2026 (pre-amendment text as pinned in the 2024 Edition); before inflation adjustment under section 63(c)(7)(B)(ii) (base year 2017) — no Rev. Proc. published amount for 2018-2024 is pinned here (SOURCE_GAP)

Pub. L. 119-21, div. B, title VII, subtitle A, ch. 1, section 70102(b)(2), 139 Stat. 159 (July 4, 2025): substitutes $15,750 for $12,000 in section 63(c)(7)(A)(ii)/(B)(ii), applicable to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024, and (per section 70102(a)) with no further sunset. Before inflation adjustment under section 63(c)(7)(B)(ii) as amended (base year 2024) — no Rev. Proc. published amount for 2025 or later is pinned here (SOURCE_GAP).
